ex.en: Never have I seen such a big whale.
ex.zh: 我從沒看過那麼大的鯨魚。

ex.en: Whales are said to have lived on land long ago.
ex.zh: 據說鯨魚很久以前是住在陸地上的。

ex.en: A wounded whale washed up on the beach.
ex.zh: 一隻受傷的鯨魚被沖上了海灘。

ex.en: The hallway needs to be wide enough for a wheelchair.
ex.zh: 走廊必須夠寬，讓輪椅能通過。

ex.en: The building isn't yet up to code because it still needs a wheelchair ramp.
ex.zh: 這棟建築還不符合法規，因為仍缺少輪椅坡道。

ex.en: We buy at wholesale prices.
ex.zh: 我們以批發價購買。

ex.en: The wholesale market opens at 4 a.m.
ex.zh: 批發市場凌晨四點開門。

ex.en: We sell wholesale to restaurants.
ex.zh: 我們以批發方式賣給餐廳。

ex.en: These goods are only sold wholesale.
ex.zh: 這些商品只批發不零售。

ex.en: The company made wholesale changes to its management.
ex.zh: 公司對管理層進行了全面改組。

ex.en: Wholesale job cuts are expected.
ex.zh: 預計會有大規模裁員。

whereby.zh: 藉此、憑此（引導說明方式的子句）

ex.en: We set up a system whereby customers can track their orders online.
ex.zh: 我們建立了一套系統，讓客戶可以在網路上追蹤訂單。

ex.en: The company introduced a plan whereby staff can work from home twice a week.
ex.zh: 公司推出一項方案，讓員工每週可以在家工作兩天。

ex.en: Her words were wholly void of meaning.
ex.zh: 她的話完全沒有意義。

ex.en: I'm not wholly convinced by his explanation.
ex.zh: 我並沒有完全被他的解釋說服。

ex.en: The company is wholly owned by a Japanese firm.
ex.zh: 這家公司由一家日本企業百分之百持有。

ex.en: Flour is made from wheat.
ex.zh: 麵粉是用小麥做的。

ex.en: Can you tell wheat from barley?
ex.zh: 你分得出小麥和大麥嗎？

ex.en: We buy our products from a wholesaler.
ex.zh: 我們向批發商進貨。

ex.en: The wholesaler offers discounts on bulk orders.
ex.zh: 這家批發商對大量訂購提供折扣。

ex.en: We were just talking about you when you called.
ex.zh: 你打電話來的時候，我們正好在聊你。

ex.en: Life begins when we realize who we really are.
ex.zh: 當我們明白自己真正是誰時，人生才開始。

ex.en: When does the store open?
ex.zh: 這家店什麼時候開門？

ex.en: When is your flight?
ex.zh: 你的班機是什麼時候？

ex.en: The day will come when you will realize it.
ex.zh: 總有一天你會明白的。

ex.en: I remember the day when we first met.
ex.zh: 我記得我們第一次見面的那天。

ex.en: What did you say?
ex.zh: 你說什麼？

ex.en: What's the problem?
ex.zh: 有什麼問題嗎？

ex.en: What subject do you think he is interested in?
ex.zh: 你覺得他會對什麼主題感興趣？

ex.en: What time does the meeting start?
ex.zh: 會議幾點開始？

ex.en: What you say is quite wide of the mark.
ex.zh: 你說的完全離題了。

ex.en: What you did brought disgrace on the whole class.
ex.zh: 你的所作所為讓全班蒙羞。

ex.en: What a beautiful day!
ex.zh: 天氣真好！

ex.en: What a great idea!
ex.zh: 真是個好主意！

ex.en: Where are you going to go on your vacation?
ex.zh: 你放假打算去哪裡玩？

ex.en: Please tell us where there is a grocery store.
ex.zh: 請告訴我們哪裡有雜貨店。

ex.en: This is where I was born and brought up.
ex.zh: 這裡就是我出生長大的地方。

ex.en: This is the village where the poet was born.
ex.zh: 這是那位詩人出生的村莊。

ex.en: I have no idea why she got so angry.
ex.zh: 我不知道她為什麼那麼生氣。

ex.en: Why are there no taxis at the station today?
ex.zh: 為什麼今天車站沒有計程車？

ex.en: Why on earth did you sell your newly-built house?
ex.zh: 你到底為什麼要把新蓋的房子賣掉？

why.zh: why don't you / why don't we：何不…（提出建議）

ex.en: Why don't you take a break?
ex.zh: 你何不休息一下？

ex.en: Why don't we meet tomorrow?
ex.zh: 我們明天見面怎麼樣？

ex.en: The phone rang while I was taking a shower.
ex.zh: 我在洗澡的時候電話響了。

ex.en: He will be my deputy while I am away.
ex.zh: 我不在的時候，他會代理我的職務。

ex.en: Don't use your phone while driving.
ex.zh: 開車時不要用手機。

ex.en: While I like the design, the price is too high.
ex.zh: 雖然我喜歡這個設計，但價格太高了。

ex.en: Some people like tea, while others prefer coffee.
ex.zh: 有些人喜歡茶，有些人則偏好咖啡。

ex.en: After a while, the man came into the room.
ex.zh: 過了一會兒，那個人走進了房間。

ex.en: I haven't seen him for a while.
ex.zh: 我有一陣子沒見到他了。

ex.en: I spent the whole day in reading the novel.
ex.zh: 我花了一整天看這本小說。

ex.en: The whole audience got up and started to applaud.
ex.zh: 全場觀眾都站起來鼓掌。

ex.en: What you did brought disgrace on the whole class.
ex.zh: 你的所作所為讓全班都丟臉。

whole.zh: on the whole / as a whole：整體來說

ex.en: On the whole I am satisfied with the result.
ex.zh: 整體來說，我對結果很滿意。

ex.en: As a whole, the plan seems to be good.
ex.zh: 整體來看，這個計畫似乎不錯。

ex.en: We have three dogs, one white and two black.
ex.zh: 我們有三隻狗，一隻白的、兩隻黑的。

ex.en: I saw a white cloud sailing across the sky.
ex.zh: 我看到一朵白雲飄過天空。

ex.en: Her skin is whiter than snow.
ex.zh: 她的皮膚比雪還白。

ex.en: Put them on the baking pan and smear them with egg whites.
ex.zh: 把它們放在烤盤上，再塗上蛋白。

ex.en: She was dressed in white.
ex.zh: 她穿著一身白。

ex.en: The wheel began to roll slowly.
ex.zh: 輪子開始慢慢轉動。

ex.en: Cars have four wheels.
ex.zh: 汽車有四個輪子。

wheel.zh: 方向盤（at the wheel：開車、掌舵）

ex.en: Japanese cars' steering wheels are on the right.
ex.zh: 日本車的方向盤在右邊。

ex.en: Tom fell asleep at the wheel.
ex.zh: 湯姆開車時睡著了。

ex.en: The nurse wheeled the patient into the room.
ex.zh: 護理師把病人推進病房。

ex.en: He wheeled his bike across the street.
ex.zh: 他牽著腳踏車過馬路。

ex.en: Whenever I hear that song, I remember my youth.
ex.zh: 每次聽到那首歌，我就會想起年輕的時候。

ex.en: Whenever I have a question, I just Google it.
ex.zh: 我一有問題就上 Google 查。

ex.en: Dinner is ready, so we can eat whenever we want.
ex.zh: 晚餐準備好了，我們想什麼時候吃都可以。

ex.en: Call me whenever you need help.
ex.zh: 需要幫忙隨時打給我。

ex.en: Tom whispered something to Mary and she smiled.
ex.zh: 湯姆小聲對瑪麗說了些什麼，她笑了。

ex.en: What did she whisper to you?
ex.zh: 她跟你說了什麼悄悄話？

ex.en: Let me whisper in your ear.
ex.zh: 我在你耳邊小聲說。

ex.en: She spoke in a whisper so she wouldn't wake the baby.
ex.zh: 她小聲說話，以免吵醒寶寶。

ex.en: I heard a whisper behind me.
ex.zh: 我聽到身後有人在低語。

wherever.zh: 無論在哪裡、在任何……的地方

ex.en: In Netherlands you can see windmills wherever you go.
ex.zh: 在荷蘭，無論走到哪裡都看得到風車。

ex.en: Tom always carries a camera with him wherever he goes.
ex.zh: 湯姆無論去哪裡都帶著相機。

ex.en: Fred followed my mother wherever she went.
ex.zh: 我母親走到哪裡，弗雷德就跟到哪裡。

whim.zh: 突然的念頭、一時的興致

ex.en: On a whim, we decided to drive to the beach.
ex.zh: 我們一時興起，決定開車去海邊。

ex.en: He bought the car on a whim.
ex.zh: 他一時興起就買下了那輛車。

ex.en: Please write the agenda on the whiteboard.
ex.zh: 請把議程寫在白板上。

ex.en: We reviewed the sales plan on the whiteboard.
ex.zh: 我們在白板上檢視了銷售計畫。

ex.en: The cargo was unloaded at the wharf.
ex.zh: 貨物在碼頭卸下。

ex.en: A small warehouse stands beside the wharf.
ex.zh: 碼頭旁有一間小型倉庫。
